book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Apocalipsis Re kwaan mlu Jesucrist lo Juan

content: Re kop or kwaan nkano yalnayii cheen Dios
Zee mbin na tub bos nye, kwaan nroo leen yidoo cheen Dios, nu nzhé lo re mandad: —Gwa gu nu bxo gu lo yizhyo gazh kop cheen yalnayii cheen na.
Zee ngwa mandad yilo nu mxo xaa kop cheen xaa lo yizhyo, zee rese xaa kwaan nkano sey cheen ma nakap nu nzholl lo maj cheen ma, mlen tub yoob kwaan ne doo nu nlaxlaa doo.
Nu lee mandad mrop mxo kop cheen leen nistoo, zee lee nistoo ngok ren, mod ren cheen xaa ngut nu ngut rese ma kwaan nzho leen nistoo.
Zee lee mandad yon ngwa nu mxo kop cheen lo re yuu nu re pa nlen nis, zee ngok reya ren.
Zee mbin na lee mandad cheen nis nzhé lo Dios: —Nali nak lu, nel sbaa ngunaab lu kwent; lu nak Dios, xaa nambey, xaa nak axta yilo,
nali naab lu kwent lo re xaa ne, nel mxo xaa ren cheen re xaa mle nambey Jesús, nu cheen re xaa mzaa kwent kwaan nzhé lu lo lee xaa, kwaanzee lu mzaa ren ngu re xaa. ¡Nzhaal ded yalzi ne!
Nu mbin na stub bos kwaan mroo pa nzo mdo cheen Dios: —Aja, Xaa Nabeyy, wli nu nali nak mod ngunaab lu kwent.
Nu lee mandad mdap mxo kop cheen tich mbizh; nu lee mbizh mkayaa yalnabeyy zek kwaan bal rese myet.
Nu rese myet nguk kwaan bal dox ne; nu ngunii re xaa nawent nak Dios, xaa nkano yalnabeyy lo rese yalzi ne; nu nanet xaa laa xaa naletra xaa re kwaan nawent kwaan kale xaa zee gool xaa lo Dios.
Nu lee mandad gaay mxo kop cheen dub paro nabeyy ma nakap, nu dub paro nabeyy ma mlake lo yalnakaw zee lee re xaa nzhawye luzh xaa lo yalne;
per nixa sneeya, namlaat xaa naletra xaa re kwaan nawent; nu ngunii xaa nawent nak Dios, xaa nzob naz yiba, kwent cheen re yoob nu yalne kwaan kaded xaa.
Nu lee mandad xop mxo kop cheen leen yuu kwaan le Éufrates; zee lee nis yuu zee tira mbizh, zee nzho mod ded re rey, xaa nze naz lad nlen mbizh, kwaan re soldad cheen xaa.
Nu myun lo na, lee roo waz nu roo ma nakap nu roo ma nawlit ngunii Dios lo, mroo chon mbi mal, kwaan nzhak kwenta ran.
Nu ran ne nak mbi mal, nu mle yon mbi mal kwaan gro, zee top mbi mal re rey nu re soldad cheen xaa, zee dil xaa mbizh gro kwaan nak cheen Dios, xaa nzho mod le rese kwaan.
Zee nzhé Jesús: —Wii gu lee na yal mod tub wann, xaa nankambazt xaa. Chul ded re xaa kwaan list nzo nu listla nkano xab, zee nazet xaa cheey zee natont xaa.
Nu mtop mbi mal re xaa tub pa le wdizh hebreo Armagedón.
Nu lee mandad gazh mxo kop cheen lo mbi yiba; nu lee tub bos nye nii mroo leen yidoo cheen Dios, kwaan nzob naz yiba, kwaan nzhé: —¡Ngulola ngoka!
Zee ngoch ngwzi, nu ngu bi cheen ngwzi; nu mgun tub xog kwaan nye doo nu namgunt stuba sbaa, axta dubse nzhi myet lo yizhyo.
Nu mselazh Dios yezh Babilonia, tub yezh ndok, nu ngoka chon leeya, leezha mxo xaa kop cheen yalnayii cheen xaa loya; nu lee rese yezh dub yizhyo mlux.
Nu lee rese yezh kwaan nzho leen nis, nu rese yi mlux,
nu naz yiba ngob yuuke ndok, kwaan nga mod choobchii kil, nu lee re myet ngunii nawent nak Dios, kwent cheen yalzi cheen yuuke, nel mded doo xaa bid.
